title: Amazing Spider-Man #2 Marvel 2014 Electro Cover Dan Slott Humberto Ramos Vol 3

description:
The Amazing Spider-Man #2 (August 2014, vol. 3), Marvel Comics - All-New Marvel NOW! Spider-Man vs. Electro. Written by Dan Slott, art and cover by Humberto Ramos with Victor Olazaba and Edgar Delgado. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: DK Marvel Encyclopedia ad.

Condition: toning and light soiling on the cream areas of the front cover, edge and corner wear, light creasing on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
